描述_EN: massive cupboard of plain polished huanghuali wood with brass fittings. the removable door panels made it easy to maneuvre stiff silk garments. it was used for storing clothes. it has a detached upper section, four-panel fronts on both upper and lower sections, and is set on square legs with decorated curvilinear aprons.
描述_ZN: 巨大的黄花梨木的普通抛光橱柜，带有黄铜配件。 可拆卸的门板使得它很容易操纵硬的丝绸服装。 它是用来储存衣服的。 它有一个独立的上部，上下两部分都有四层的正面，设置在方形的腿上，有装饰的曲线形围裙。
